text:
jin: quick sync — putting forward a new candidate for onboarding: orca-lite-13b. need to decide priority vs quant experiments this sprint. short TL;DR below.

sara: thanks. can you paste the current eval perf and resource ask?

jin: sure — current numbers from local bench:
```
- FP16 perf (bs=1): p95 = 120ms, throughput = 25 tok/s
- INT8 quantized baseline: p95 ~ 80ms, throughput ~ 45 tok/s
- model size: 13.1B weights (~26GB fp16)
- expected dedicated GPU: A10x-48 or T4x2 for initial trials
```

mike: looks promising on int8. did you run the llm-eval suite we use for hallucination/regression?

jin: ran quick subset — pass on CR and coherence, borderline on long-context summarization (drop ~4.2% vs prod model). full eval queued in repo under /evals/orca-lite-13b.

alex: what's the ask for prioritization? are we blocking a customer or roadmap?

jin: roadmap alignment: product asked for a cheaper RE-RANK baseline to test in search, not blocking but high ROI if quant behaves. estimation: 2 engineer-weeks to do full quant pipeline + bench + evals.

luis: can we slot this behind the atlas/40b work? we have limited quant infra.

sara: proposals: (1) high-priority: run full quant experiments this sprint (requires infra bump), (2) medium: limited int8 dry-run on existing infra, (3) low: queue after our current onboard queue. which do we pick?

mike: vote: medium. run int8 on existing infra first, validate eval regressions. if good, promote to high and schedule dedicated resources.

jin: +1 medium. ordering suggestion: run smoke quant + eval subset (2 days), then decision point.

alex: assigning: @jin to run smoke quant, @mike to review eval diffs, @luis to confirm infra availability. can we add a quick checklist in-thread so we're clear?

jin: yes — checklist: 
- "smoke quant" (int8 static quant) on sample shard — owner: jin — due: 2d
- full llm-eval run (regression + hallucination suites) — owner: mike — due: 5d
- perf bench (p95, throughput) across bs=1/4/8 — owner: jin/luis — due: 5d
- rollout gating metrics defined (max allowed regression, latency SLO) — owner: sara — due: end of sprint
- infra reserve if promoted (A10x-48 1wk) — owner: luis — tentative

mike: small nit — add "compare against current prod-re-ranker (metrics: mrr@10, latency, token-cost)"

jin: added.

eval-bot: new eval job queued: /evals/orca-lite-13b/quick-smoke — job_id=eval-8732 — status: queued

luis: infra note: we have a 3-day window opens wed-thu for ephemeral A10 slots, can use that if promoted. otherwise T4s will work for smoke.

sara: decision: go medium. jin start smoke now. mike run evals asap. if smoke perf matches int8 numbers and eval regressions <2% on key metrics, we escalate to high.

alex: +1. please post results here as short bullets (p95, mrr@10 diff, hallucination delta).

jin: will do. starting smoke quant now.

mike: I'll kick off the regression suite after smoke completes. ping when job_id available.

sara: thanks all. quick sync tomorrow 10am for decision. :calendar:

jin: noted. thanks. :thumbsup:
